page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a heading and signature line below the main paragraph. The running head is at the top, and a section numeral is printed at the foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Ac sæpe memorato generoso ipsius Legato, cujus in negotiis istis tractandis, singularem fidem & dexteritatem summa cum pietate & prudentia conjunctam merito commendat, gratiam suam ac favorem Regium benigne promittit.

p.i: Signatum in Regia ipsius Majestatis Haber-stebia, idibus Martii, a nato communi[?] Redemptore Jesu Chrifto anno 1584.

main_text.head: FREDERICUS

page.notes: The signature line is set in italic with some words in heavier type; "communi" is uncertain. The line "Ac sæpe" begins with a dropped initial that reads as plain text. The "VII." at the foot right is taken as a printed section numeral and not a gathering signature.
